content:
The task failed because modified paragraphs in the HWPX document incorrectly retained their layout cache elements.
The verifier failed in test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache with an AssertionError. Specifically, modified paragraphs still contained the 'hp:linesegarray' element, which should have been removed to invalidate the layout cache. The failure occurred in section0.xml or section1.xml when checking fragments like '예산' or '단계' after string replacement. Avoid leaving stale XML layout metadata when updating paragraph text.
